svg.title: How each part is counted
svg.desc: Three ways the parts are counted: HCP Terraform per resource, per month, rated hourly, with Terraform Enterprise self-managed; a license for each server in a Nomad Enterprise cluster; IBM NS1 Connect plans measured in DNS queries per month, with DNS records and health check monitors per plan.
